cues.text: A dark shape writhes inside a translucent, fleshy sac. Red veins web the pulsing surface.
Viscous slime stretches as it breaks free.
The dark, metallic Craver inspects its claws.
The hatchling stands among hundreds of glowing sacs.
They carpet the floor of a massive, fleshy cavern, stretching into the haze.
Another towering Craver strides past in the foreground, its dark armor gleaming.

beats.note: Close up of a translucent, fleshy sac with red veins. A dark shape moves inside.
The sac tears open. A dark, metallic creature pulls itself out, viscous slime stretching from its body.
The creature stands, looking at its clawed hand.
The view pulls back to reveal a massive cavern.
Hundreds of glowing sacs cover the cavern floor.
Another Craver walks past in the foreground.
